literal_meaning: এক (one) + ঘেয়ে (bored or monotonous, from ঘেয়া meaning to become stale or tiresome)
figurative_meaning_en: Lacking novelty, annoying, without variety, always the same
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজটা একঘেয়ে হয়ে গেছে, কিছু পরিবর্তন দরকার।
তার বক্তৃতা একঘেয়ে, কোনো নতুনত্ব নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: This job has become monotonous; it needs some change.
His speech is monotonous, with no novelty at all.
note: This idiom is derived from the concept of something becoming stale like overused food, common in Bengali expressive language.
